title.narrative: A THREE-DAY NATIONAL CONFERENCE ON HARNESSING AI TECHNIQUES FOR EFFICIENT INFORMATION MANAGEMENT AND RETRIEVAL

description.narrative: The National Conference on Harnessing AI techniques for Efficient Information Management and Retrieval will create a wider awareness on UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI, and the advantages of harnessing AI techniques, while reinforcing UNESCO’s position as a global leader in shaping the future of this technology. It will offer ways to automate document-driven processes within any work environment. It will further create an ecosystem that will support AI solutions for overall development, and improved policy-making in the nation, considering the ongoing development of the National AI Strategy by the Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy.
